       if re.search(r"^\s{4}class:\s*safe_local_remediation\s*$", b, re.M)]

          "policy_class": "safe_local_remediation", "action_recordable_in_schema": "true",
          "recovery_verified": "false", "docker_daemon": "unreachable-at-rehearsal"}
REQUIRED = ["drill_id", "claim", "mode", "live_container_operation", "remediation_action",
            "policy_class", "action_recordable_in_schema", "recovery_verified",
            "docker_daemon", "evidence_citation"]
CITATIONS = ["docs/criteria/scoring_map/telemetry.md", "incident-response/autonomy-policy.yaml",
             "incident-response/response.schema.json", "README.md"]

def rows_of(t):
    out = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"^\|\s*ONCALL_DRILL\s*\|\s*([a-z_]+)\s*\|\s*([^|]*?)\s*\|\s*$", t, re.M):
        out[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)

def answer_of(t):
    blocks = re.findall(r"```json\s*\n(.*?)\n```", t, re.S)

def legs(t):
    """The decisive assertions of this AC; returns a list of defects (empty = pass)."""

    if len(rows) < len(REQUIRED):
        fail.append("the carrier carries %d ONCALL_DRILL rows, fewer than the %d required - the row form is the contract, prose is not" % (len(rows), len(REQUIRED)))

        if k in rows and rows[k] != want:

                "mode": "this environment has no working docker daemon; a mode other than documented-rehearsal would claim a live drill the card cannot prove",

                "policy_class": "the class the drill exercises is the third class t123 added",
                "action_recordable_in_schema": "if the action were not recordable, ac1 would not have landed",
                "recovery_verified": "recovery is asserted only by the merged recovery-verification step; the schema pins the literal false",
                "docker_daemon": "the daemon state is the honest half of the documented-only disclosure"}[k]))
    unknown = sorted(set(rows) - set(REQUIRED))

        fail.append("the row table carries unknown field(s) %s - the field set is closed so a mutated or invented row cannot smuggle a claim in" % unknown)
    act = rows.get("remediation_action", "")
    if act and act not in rem:
        fail.append("the recorded action %r is not a policy id of class safe_local_remediation (policy has %s) - the drill may only record what the policy allows (if the policy has no such class yet, t123's product has not merged: disclosed blocker, not a workaround)" % (act, rem or "none"))

        fail.append("the recorded action %r is not in the schema enum - the drill recorded something the answer contract cannot carry" % act)
    if rows.get("live_container_operation") == "true" and rows.get("docker_daemon") == "unreachable-at-rehearsal":
        fail.append("the carrier claims a live container operation while stating the daemon was unreachable - a self-contradiction is corruption, not a claim")
    for c in CITATIONS:
        if c not in t:
            fail.append("the carrier never cites %s - the drill record must point at the policy, the schema, the claim carrier and the scoring map, not float free" % c)
